approach_options.title: JOIN-only (ticket lead)
approach_options.change: Delete `AND a.id IN (SELECT address_id FROM address_links)`; keep INNER JOIN address_links.
approach_options.risk: May disable public_address PK prune and worsen the scan (Rollup header: IN is load-bearing; Geohash: JOIN hashes 100M+ public_address).

approach_options.title: Prune-first then join metadata
approach_options.change: Subquery public_address WHERE id IN (address_links) first (Geohash-style prune), then join the small result to address_links for is_staged/hotlist_id.
approach_options.risk: Still one CH round-trip; needs EXPLAIN to confirm prune happens.

approach_options.title: Two-step: metadata + chunked id IN lookups
approach_options.change: Query address_links metadata once; chunk address ids; fetch public_address rows via explicit id IN lists (PK lookups); merge in PHP.
approach_options.risk: More round-trips; larger PHP change; likely most predictable under CH join quirks.

approach_options.title: PG hybrid — zod.hotlist_address metadata + CH public_address id IN
approach_options.change: Resolve open Direct/Staging address_ids + hotlist metadata from Postgres (indexed by hotlist_id); fetch coords from zod.public_address via chunked id IN. Avoids CH public_hotlist_address entirely.
approach_options.risk: Cross-store consistency/CDC lag; needs staging-org join parity with current CH filter.

notes: Ticket text said 30-minute cache; code ADDRESS_CACHE_TTL_MINUTES = 15 (authoritative).
ClickhouseQuery::query() catches CH errors and returns [] in prod — timeouts look like empty address sets, not thrown exceptions in the command's per-org catch.
Failed Cache::remember callbacks are not cached — every cycle retries the expensive query until it succeeds.
WWDD (platform lens, incident/perf): measure before building; do not raise timeout as primary fix; do not trust SQL-level 'redundancy' over documented CH planner guidance.
Exact JOIN+IN public_address sites in repo: ScoutOpenOrderAddressesQuery (in scope) + ScoutCheckInRollupQuery (deferred).

Q3 clarification: there is no platform.hotlist in ClickHouse. Hotlists are clarity.hotlist (already in the query) / zod.public_hotlist. The expensive table is zod.public_hotlist_address ORDER BY id. PG zod.hotlist_address (Eloquent HotlistAddress) is a viable alternate link source that avoids the CH full scan without altering CH DDL.

Measurement used Cloud via clarity_clickhouse. Local CLICKHOUSE_TIMEOUT_QUERY=20 (client); prod symptom cited server max_execution_time=30. Approach A rejected. Approach B wins among single-statement shapes measured.
